plainTranslation: Warm, affectionate, naturally drawn together. The Venus person adores the Sun person; the Sun person feels appreciated and seen. One of the gentlest attraction contacts. Failure mode: pleasant but passive - lots of warmth, little drive. Enjoy the affection, and make sure something supplies the momentum.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryShort: You find them actually lovely, and being around them feels warm and easy.
summaryDeep: You find them actually lovely, and being around them feels warm and easy. Affection and admiration flow, sometimes tipping into idealizing them. Enjoy the warmth and still see them clearly.
tension: The thing to watch is that pleasant can stay shallow. If everything stays nice and nobody ever pushes past the easy surface, the connection can stall at "we get along great" without becoming much deeper.
advice: Let yourself enjoy it, but don't stop at nice. Liking someone is a good start, not the whole story.
